title: Lumpy and pretty clear when you look at it from one side
text:
Lumpy and pretty clear when you look at it from one side. I don't know if you are supposed to be able to see thru selenite like glass but on one side of this, I can see into it perfectly like it was just a glass ball. The ball is lumpy and not smooth at all, looks a bit goofy when you are holding it and looking at it.

The base is kinda cheap looking and they put some ugly red felt on top so when the crystal is on top of the base, the red shows up clear at the top of the crystal and looks goofy. So i'll definitely be changing the fabric out under the crystal to something white.

Bottom line for me? Not worth $26 at all! This ball should be more like $10 for how goofy it and the stand looks.
